title: Synthetic direct-escalation fixture without a handoff configuration
description: Constructed corpus fixture carrying an escalate exception and no escalation object, so a direct handoff request has no Core-defined destination. Synthetic content for specification testing; it authorizes nothing.

decision.intent: Exercise a direct exception escalation in a pack that supplies no handoff configuration.
decision.question: Should this synthetic request be approved, held, or handed off?

rules.description: Approve the request once it is marked ready.
Hold the request while it is marked not ready.

exceptions.description: A flagged request is handed to a person regardless of readiness; this pack declares no handoff configuration, so the request names no destination.
